completed_actions.action: Define safe-word authorization so no action is authorized unless a safe word has been selected and the selected word approves the printed plan.

completion_evidence.observed_content: The rule states that no action may occur before the user selects a safe word and uses that selected word to approve the displayed plan; ordinary or implied approval is explicitly non-authorization.

completed_actions.action: Define the action set broadly and insert 25 unique typical actions with an evaluation explaining why each qualifies.

completion_evidence.observed_content: Live readback shows 25 distinct action_id entries from create_file through generate_artifact; each entry contains action, classification=action, and an evaluation tied to creation, mutation, deletion, checking, inspection, review, retrieval, execution, or semantic analogy.

The committed rule defines deciding an action plan, printing it to UI, and printing action/pre-action definitions as pre-actions, while distinguishing hidden external reads/checks/tool calls as actions.

completed_actions.action: Require the complete defined action plan before requesting permission and create the action-plan return JSON schema with actions, necessary subactions, definitions, ambiguous terms, and dependency mappings.

completion_evidence.observed_content: The embedded draft-2020-12 JSON Schema requires plan_id, status, safe_word_required, safe_word_selected, permission_request_scope, actions, subactions, definitions, ambiguous_terms, dependencies, approval, and post_approval_change_control. completed_actions.action: Freeze an approved plan against additions and allow its shape to change only by removing uncompleted actions or subactions.

completion_evidence.observed_content: The committed rule says no actions or subactions may be added after approval and permits only removal of work that has not been completed; new dependencies require a new plan and new safe-word approval.

completion_evidence.observed_content: The committed artifact was fetched from main after creation and its requested rule structures and examples were directly observed.
